sections.title: Be respectful
sections.body: No harassment, hate speech, or personal attacks. Debate ideas, not people.

sections.title: Original articles
sections.body: Posts should be your own writing or clearly credited. Do not copy entire rulebooks or Wikipedia articles without attribution.

sections.title: Spoilers & NSFW
sections.body: Mark spoilers for Hunters stories and compendium lore. Adult content belongs in marked channels only.

sections.title: MN2 & crypto claims
sections.body: Do not promise guaranteed returns. Reward claims must link to official platform APIs.

sections.title: Moderation
sections.body: Staff may hide posts, issue warnings, or ban repeat offenders. Report abuse via Support tab or Agent Support tickets.

sections.title: Paragraphs & rights-law
sections.body: Legal paragraphs in the Rights tab are reference material — not legal advice. Cite paragraph numbers when discussing rules.
